title: 高频动词短语
description: 最常用的动词短语与动词搭配：give up、take advantage of、make up one's mind……日常交流与阅读中随处可见。

entries.example: She took advantage of the quiet morning to finish her report.
entries.translation: 她利用安静的早晨写完了报告。

entries.example: He gave up smoking after his doctor's warning.
entries.translation: 医生警告之后，他戒了烟。

entries.example: We are looking forward to the summer holiday.
entries.translation: 我们都在盼着暑假。

entries.example: After weeks of thinking, she made up her mind to study abroad.
entries.translation: 考虑了几周之后，她下定决心出国留学。

entries.example: They put off the meeting until next Friday.
entries.translation: 他们把会议推迟到了下周五。

entries.example: The team carried out a survey of local residents.
entries.translation: 团队对当地居民做了一次调查。

entries.example: I can't figure out how this machine works.
entries.translation: 我弄不明白这台机器是怎么运转的。

entries.example: Our manager came up with a clever solution.
entries.translation: 我们经理想出了一个巧妙的办法。

entries.example: Her grandmother looks after the children on weekdays.
entries.translation: 工作日由她奶奶照看孩子们。

entries.example: The police promised to look into the matter.
entries.translation: 警方承诺会调查此事。

entries.example: I ran into an old classmate at the station.
entries.translation: 我在车站碰到了一位老同学。

entries.example: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
entries.translation: 牛奶喝完了，所以我去了趟商店。

entries.example: She set up her own company at the age of thirty.
entries.translation: 她三十岁时创办了自己的公司。

entries.example: He turned down the job offer because of the long commute.
entries.translation: 因为通勤太远，他拒绝了那份工作。

entries.example: She brought up an interesting point during the discussion.
entries.translation: 她在讨论中提出了一个有意思的观点。

entries.example: The teacher pointed out a few mistakes in my essay.
entries.translation: 老师指出了我作文里的几处错误。

entries.example: Nurses have to deal with stressful situations every day.
entries.translation: 护士每天都要应对紧张的局面。

entries.example: She gets along with everyone in the office.
entries.translation: 她和办公室里每个人都相处得很好。

entries.example: It is hard to keep up with the latest technology.
entries.translation: 要跟上最新的技术并不容易。

entries.example: Go ahead, and I'll catch up with you later.
entries.translation: 你先走，我待会儿追上你。

entries.example: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
entries.translation: 这噪音我再也受不了了。

entries.example: We need to get rid of these old boxes.
entries.translation: 我们得把这些旧箱子处理掉。

entries.example: The country went through a difficult period after the war.
entries.translation: 战后这个国家经历了一段艰难时期。

entries.example: We got lost and ended up in a small village.
entries.translation: 我们迷了路，最后到了一个小村子。

entries.example: The rumour turned out to be false.
entries.translation: 那个传言原来是假的。

entries.example: We finally worked out a plan that suited everyone.
entries.translation: 我们终于想出了一个人人都满意的方案。

entries.example: The match was called off because of heavy rain.
entries.translation: 由于大雨，比赛取消了。

entries.example: Our car broke down on the way to the airport.
entries.translation: 我们的车在去机场的路上抛锚了。

entries.example: A fire broke out in the kitchen last night.
entries.translation: 昨晚厨房里起了火。

entries.example: Only half of the guests showed up on time.
entries.translation: 只有一半客人准时到场。

entries.example: Please hand in your homework before Monday.
entries.translation: 请在周一前交作业。

entries.example: Fill in your name and address on this form.
entries.translation: 在这张表上填写你的姓名和地址。

entries.example: I called the station to find out when the train leaves.
entries.translation: 我给车站打电话，问火车什么时候开。

entries.example: A larger firm took over the company last year.
entries.translation: 去年一家更大的公司收购了这家公司。

entries.example: My father took up painting after he retired.
entries.translation: 我父亲退休后开始学画画。

entries.example: The plane took off half an hour late.
entries.translation: 飞机晚了半小时起飞。

entries.example: She picked up some Spanish while travelling.
entries.translation: 她在旅行中学会了一些西班牙语。

entries.example: I promised to help, and I won't let you down.
entries.translation: 我答应过帮忙，就不会让你失望。

entries.example: You can always count on her in a crisis.
entries.translation: 遇到危机时你总可以依靠她。

entries.example: Many farmers rely on rain for their crops.
entries.translation: 许多农民靠天下雨来浇灌庄稼。

entries.example: She found it hard to cope with the pressure.
entries.translation: 她觉得很难应付这种压力。

entries.example: The letters UN stand for United Nations.
entries.translation: 字母 UN 代表联合国。

entries.example: Her red coat stands out in the crowd.
entries.translation: 她的红外套在人群中很显眼。

entries.example: Hold on, I need to find my keys.
entries.translation: 等一下，我得找找钥匙。

entries.example: I looked up the word in my dictionary.
entries.translation: 我在词典里查了这个词。

entries.example: He looks down on people who didn't go to university.
entries.translation: 他看不起没上过大学的人。

entries.example: As a boy, he looked up to his older brother.
entries.translation: 小时候他很崇拜他的哥哥。

entries.example: Your explanation makes sense to me.
entries.translation: 你的解释我觉得说得通。

entries.example: I couldn't make sense of the instructions.
entries.translation: 我看不懂这份说明。

entries.example: Pay attention to the road when you are driving.
entries.translation: 开车时要注意路况。

entries.example: Over a thousand runners took part in the race.
entries.translation: 一千多名选手参加了这场比赛。

entries.example: The wedding took place in a small church.
entries.translation: 婚礼在一座小教堂里举行。

entries.example: Don't worry about the bills; I'll take care of them.
entries.translation: 账单别担心，我来处理。

entries.example: You should take into account the cost of travel.
entries.translation: 你应该把交通费用考虑进去。

entries.example: A little kindness makes a difference.
entries.translation: 一点点善意就能带来改变。

entries.example: The patient has made good progress since the operation.
entries.translation: 手术后病人恢复得很好。

entries.example: He made an effort to be friendly to the new staff.
entries.translation: 他尽力对新员工友好一些。

entries.example: We need to make a decision by tomorrow.
entries.translation: 我们得在明天之前做出决定。

entries.example: I made a mistake in the last question.
entries.translation: 最后一题我做错了。

entries.example: He did his best, but he still lost the game.
entries.translation: 他已经尽力了，但还是输了比赛。

entries.example: Let's keep in touch after you move to Canada.
entries.translation: 你搬去加拿大以后，我们保持联系吧。

entries.example: I lost touch with most of my school friends.
entries.translation: 我和大部分中学同学都断了联系。

entries.example: It took me months to get used to the cold weather.
entries.translation: 我花了好几个月才习惯这里的寒冷天气。

entries.example: Please get in touch with us if you have any questions.
entries.translation: 如有任何问题，请与我们联系。

entries.example: Stop chatting and get on with your work.
entries.translation: 别聊了，接着干活。

entries.example: It took her a long time to get over the loss.
entries.translation: 她过了很久才从失去亲人的痛苦中走出来。

entries.example: Music helped him get through the hard times.
entries.translation: 音乐帮他熬过了那段艰难的日子。

entries.example: After hours of argument, he finally gave in.
entries.translation: 争论了几个小时后，他终于让步了。

entries.example: She gave away most of her books when she moved.
entries.translation: 搬家时她把大部分书都送人了。

entries.example: The meeting went on for three hours.
entries.translation: 会议持续了三个小时。

entries.example: Let's go over the plan once more.
entries.translation: 我们再把计划过一遍。

entries.example: We used to hang out at the café after class.
entries.translation: 我们以前下课后常在那家咖啡馆待着。

entries.example: She held back her tears during the speech.
entries.translation: 演讲时她忍住了眼泪。

entries.example: He kept on asking the same question.
entries.translation: 他一直问同一个问题。

entries.example: You left out an important detail.
entries.translation: 你漏掉了一个重要细节。

entries.example: The film didn't live up to my expectations.
entries.translation: 这部电影没有达到我的期望。

entries.example: He bought her flowers to make up for being late.
entries.translation: 他买了花给她，作为迟到的补偿。

entries.example: His grandfather passed away last spring.
entries.translation: 他的祖父去年春天去世了。

entries.example: The driver pulled over to check the map.
entries.translation: 司机把车停到路边看地图。

entries.example: The committee put forward several new proposals.
entries.translation: 委员会提出了几项新建议。

entries.example: Put on your coat; it's freezing outside.
entries.translation: 穿上外套，外面冷极了。

entries.example: Firefighters quickly put out the fire.
entries.translation: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。

entries.example: The doctor ruled out a serious illness.
entries.translation: 医生排除了患重病的可能。

entries.example: We went to the airport to see off our cousin.
entries.translation: 我们去机场给表哥送行。

entries.example: We set off early to avoid the traffic.
entries.translation: 为了避开堵车，我们很早就出发了。

entries.example: After years of travelling, they decided to settle down.
entries.translation: 漂泊多年之后，他们决定安定下来。

entries.example: The factory shut down after forty years.
entries.translation: 这家工厂开了四十年后关门了。

entries.example: I need to sort out my papers before the trip.
entries.translation: 出发前我得把文件整理好。

entries.example: Could you speak up? I can't hear you at the back.
entries.translation: 你能大声点吗？我在后面听不见。

entries.example: Try to stick to your budget this month.
entries.translation: 这个月尽量按预算花钱。

entries.example: She takes after her mother in many ways.
entries.translation: 她在很多方面都像她妈妈。

entries.example: Don't answer now; think it over first.
entries.translation: 现在先别回答，好好考虑一下。

entries.example: He threw away all his old shoes.
entries.translation: 他把旧鞋全扔了。

entries.example: You can try out the software for free.
entries.translation: 这个软件你可以免费试用。

entries.example: He turned up at the party without warning.
entries.translation: 他事先没打招呼就出现在了聚会上。

entries.example: We have used up all the paper in the printer.
entries.translation: 打印机里的纸都用完了。

entries.example: I woke up at six this morning.
entries.translation: 我今天早上六点就醒了。

entries.example: Watch out! There's a car coming.
entries.translation: 小心！有车来了。

entries.example: The flood wiped out the entire harvest.
entries.translation: 洪水毁掉了全部收成。

entries.example: She is working on a new novel.
entries.translation: 她正在写一部新小说。

entries.example: Tourism accounts for a third of the city's income.
entries.translation: 旅游业占这座城市收入的三分之一。

entries.example: His story just doesn't add up.
entries.translation: 他的说法根本讲不通。

entries.example: Make sure you back up your files every week.
entries.translation: 记得每周备份一次文件。

entries.example: The soldiers blew up the bridge to stop the enemy.
entries.translation: 士兵们炸毁了桥，以阻止敌人前进。

entries.example: Someone broke into our house while we were away.
entries.translation: 我们不在家时，有人闯进了屋子。

entries.example: The band broke up after their third album.
entries.translation: 这支乐队在第三张专辑后解散了。

entries.example: The internet has brought about huge changes in education.
entries.translation: 互联网给教育带来了巨大变化。

entries.example: This song brings back memories of my childhood.
entries.translation: 这首歌让我想起了童年。

entries.example: This situation calls for immediate action.
entries.translation: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。

entries.example: Take a deep breath and calm down.
entries.translation: 深呼吸，冷静下来。

entries.example: Sorry to interrupt; please carry on.
entries.translation: 抱歉打断了，请继续。

entries.example: You need to check in two hours before the flight.
entries.translation: 你需要在航班起飞前两小时办理登机。

entries.example: Cheer up! Things will get better soon.
entries.translation: 振作点！情况很快就会好起来的。

entries.example: I came across an old photo in the drawer.
entries.translation: 我在抽屉里偶然发现了一张老照片。

entries.example: A few problems came up during the test.
entries.translation: 测试中出现了几个问题。

entries.example: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar.
entries.translation: 医生让他少吃糖。

entries.example: The price depends on the size of the room.
entries.translation: 价格取决于房间大小。

entries.example: Feel free to drop by if you are in the area.
entries.translation: 如果你在附近，随时过来坐坐。

entries.example: He dropped out of college to start a business.
entries.translation: 他从大学退学去创业了。

entries.example: Their plans fell apart when the funding ran out.
entries.translation: 资金用完后，他们的计划就泡汤了。

entries.example: He fell behind in class after his illness.
entries.translation: 生病之后他的功课落下了。

entries.example: His speech failed to get across the main message.
entries.translation: 他的演讲没能把主要意思讲清楚。

entries.example: He cheated on the test and got away with it.
entries.translation: 他考试作弊，却没受到任何处罚。

entries.example: Go ahead and start eating; don't wait for me.
entries.translation: 你们先吃吧，别等我。

entries.example: My alarm went off at five o'clock.
entries.translation: 我的闹钟五点就响了。

entries.example: The bookshop went out of business last year.
entries.translation: 那家书店去年倒闭了。

entries.example: She grew up in a small town by the sea.
entries.translation: 她在海边的一个小镇长大。

entries.example: The volunteers handed out water to the runners.
entries.translation: 志愿者给跑步的人分发饮用水。

entries.example: After lunch, we headed for the beach.
entries.translation: 午饭后，我们朝海滩走去。

entries.example: Sorry I'm late; I was held up in traffic.
entries.translation: 抱歉我来晚了，路上堵车耽搁了。

entries.example: When the music started, everyone joined in.
entries.translation: 音乐一响，大家都加入了进来。

entries.example: Keep away from the edge of the cliff.
entries.translation: 离悬崖边远一点。

entries.example: Keep out! This area is dangerous.
entries.translation: 禁止入内！这里很危险。

entries.example: The company laid off two hundred workers.
entries.translation: 公司裁掉了两百名员工。

entries.example: Open the window to let in some fresh air.
entries.translation: 打开窗户透透新鲜空气。

entries.example: You need a password to log in.
entries.translation: 登录需要密码。

entries.example: Look out for pickpockets in the market.
entries.translation: 在市场里要提防小偷。

entries.example: She looked through the report before the meeting.
entries.translation: 开会前她把报告翻了一遍。

entries.example: I couldn't make out what he was saying.
entries.translation: 我听不清他在说什么。

entries.example: I always mix up the twins' names.
entries.translation: 我总是把这对双胞胎的名字弄混。

entries.meaning: 继续前进；开始新的事情
entries.example: It's time to forget the past and move on.
entries.translation: 该忘掉过去，继续往前走了。

entries.example: We narrowed down the list to three candidates.
entries.translation: 我们把名单缩小到三名候选人。

entries.example: Please pass on my thanks to your team.
entries.translation: 请代我向你的团队致谢。

entries.example: I'll pay back the money next week.
entries.translation: 我下周还钱。

entries.example: All her hard work finally paid off.
entries.translation: 她的努力终于有了回报。

entries.example: She picked out a blue dress for the party.
entries.translation: 她为聚会挑了一条蓝裙子。

entries.example: Put away your toys before dinner.
entries.translation: 吃饭前把玩具收好。

entries.example: It took us two hours to put together the bookshelf.
entries.translation: 我们花了两个小时才把书架装好。

entries.example: The charity reached out to families in need.
entries.translation: 这家慈善机构主动联系有困难的家庭。

entries.example: The dog ran away when it heard the thunder.
entries.translation: 狗听到雷声就跑掉了。

entries.example: It was easy to see through his excuse.
entries.translation: 他的借口很容易被识破。

entries.example: The concert tickets sold out in ten minutes.
entries.translation: 音乐会门票十分钟就卖光了。

entries.example: Try to set aside some money every month.
entries.translation: 每个月尽量存一点钱。

entries.example: He likes to show off his new car.
entries.translation: 他喜欢炫耀他的新车。

entries.example: I signed up for a cooking class.
entries.translation: 我报了一个烹饪班。

entries.example: Please slow down; you're driving too fast.
entries.translation: 请慢一点，你开得太快了。

entries.example: We need to speed up the process.
entries.translation: 我们得加快进度。

entries.example: I stayed up late to watch the match.
entries.translation: 我熬夜看了比赛。

entries.example: The chairman stepped down after the scandal.
entries.translation: 丑闻之后董事长辞职了。

entries.example: Remember to switch off the lights when you leave.
entries.translation: 离开时记得关灯。

entries.example: He took apart the radio to see how it worked.
entries.translation: 他把收音机拆开，想看看它是怎么工作的。

entries.example: I'm sorry; I take back what I said.
entries.translation: 对不起，我收回刚才的话。

entries.example: I finally talked my father into buying a new phone.
entries.translation: 我终于说服爸爸买了部新手机。

entries.example: His friends talked him out of quitting his job.
entries.translation: 朋友们劝他别辞职。

entries.example: Can you tell apart the two sisters?
entries.translation: 你分得清这对姐妹吗？

entries.example: I can't think of a good title for my essay.
entries.translation: 我想不出作文的好标题。

entries.example: The child threw up after eating too much candy.
entries.translation: 那孩子吃了太多糖，吐了。

entries.example: Let's tidy up the room before the guests arrive.
entries.translation: 客人来之前我们把房间收拾一下。

entries.example: The small café turned into a popular restaurant.
entries.translation: 那家小咖啡馆变成了一家热门餐厅。

entries.example: When she was in trouble, she turned to her teacher for help.
entries.translation: 遇到麻烦时，她去找老师帮忙。

entries.example: Always warm up before you go running.
entries.translation: 跑步前一定要先热身。

entries.example: He wore out two pairs of shoes on the trip.
entries.translation: 这次旅行他穿坏了两双鞋。

entries.example: Write down the address so you don't forget it.
entries.translation: 把地址记下来，免得忘了。

entries.example: When she heard the news, she burst into tears.
entries.translation: 听到消息，她一下子哭了出来。

entries.example: Wait a moment; let me catch my breath.
entries.translation: 等一下，让我喘口气。

entries.example: He changed his mind at the last minute.
entries.translation: 他在最后一刻改变了主意。

entries.example: Her dream of becoming a pilot finally came true.
entries.translation: 她当飞行员的梦想终于实现了。

entries.example: It is too early to draw a conclusion.
entries.translation: 现在下结论还为时过早。

entries.example: I fell asleep in the middle of the film.
entries.translation: 电影看到一半我就睡着了。

entries.example: They fell in love with the old house at first sight.
entries.translation: 他们第一眼就爱上了这座老房子。

entries.example: I'm finally getting the hang of this new software.
entries.translation: 我终于摸清这个新软件的用法了。

entries.example: Could you give me a hand with these bags?
entries.translation: 你能帮我拿一下这些包吗？

entries.example: Can I have a word with you after the meeting?
entries.translation: 会后我能和你谈谈吗？

entries.example: Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
entries.translation: 你能帮我看一下包吗？

entries.example: She promised to come, and she kept her word.
entries.translation: 她答应过要来，她也说到做到了。

entries.example: He lost his temper when the train was cancelled again.
entries.translation: 火车又一次取消时，他发火了。

entries.example: She quickly made friends with her new neighbours.
entries.translation: 她很快就和新邻居交上了朋友。

entries.example: We moved the sofa to make room for the piano.
entries.translation: 我们挪开沙发，给钢琴腾地方。

entries.example: Let's make the most of the sunny weather.
entries.translation: 我们好好利用这晴朗的天气吧。

entries.example: Don't worry; I'm just pulling your leg.
entries.translation: 别担心，我只是跟你开个玩笑。

entries.example: If you don't save your work, you run the risk of losing it.
entries.translation: 不保存的话，你可能会丢掉所有内容。

entries.example: Let's take a break and get some coffee.
entries.translation: 我们休息一下，去喝杯咖啡吧。

entries.example: The doctor told him to take it easy for a few days.
entries.translation: 医生让他这几天好好休息。

entries.example: Our school led the way in recycling.
entries.translation: 我们学校在垃圾回收方面走在前列。
